description: Start an export in the open editor. REQUIRES confirmPlan: the exact export plan the user explicitly confirmed (e.g. "720P/60fps/mp4/high") — state the plan (tier/fps/format/quality) to the user, get an explicit yes, and only then call this tool with that summary; never fabricate it. A vague "directly export"/"just export it" is NOT confirmation — state the exact plan in one line and ask first. EVERY export is explicitly confirmed even when memory or prior sessions contain previous choices — memory is not authorization: offer remembered settings as the default ("last time 1080P/60fps/MP4/high — same again?") and wait for an explicit yes or adjustment. Defaults are 60fps/high; deviations must be proposed, never chosen silently. Tier menu (adapted from user.loggedIn/user.subscribed in poindeo_get_project): 720P (free) / 1080P / 1440P (2K) / 4K, each at 60fps high (fps 10-120, quality standard/high/ultra adjustable); mark what is missing — not logged in → (login + subscribe), logged in but unsubscribed → (subscribe). Free exports carry a brand watermark — mention it. If the user picks a paid tier they lack, do NOT call this tool — hand login/subscription back to the user instead (top-right avatar to sign in; crown icon in the editor header or the /pricing link to subscribe — mention the unlock path EVERY time you state a restriction), then verify with user.refresh before exporting. NEEDS_LOGIN errors mean that pre-check was missed — retry after the user logs in. GIF: ask size/fps/quality; image: ask which frame + format/quality. Pass-through export.start settings: type (video default / gif / image current-frame), resolution (video: 720P default, above 720P needs subscription), fps (default 60), format, quality, range (current scene/all), maxWidth/gifFps/gifQuality (gif), imageFormat/imageQuality (image). The project aspect ratio applies automatically. Returns immediately; then poll poindeo_export_status until completed — the finished file is written directly to disk (outputDir defaults to ~/Downloads, the browser download folder; "just download it" needs no explicit directory) and its absolute path returned; the file is highlighted in the file manager when done (reveal:false to disable). Exports render in an offscreen worker and work while the editor tab is backgrounded.

confirmPlan.description: Required confirmation gate. Pass the export plan the user explicitly confirmed, as a short summary string (e.g. "720P/60fps/mp4/high"). Only pass it after stating the exact plan to the user and receiving an explicit yes — a vague go-ahead like "just export it" is NOT confirmation: restate the parameters and wait for the yes first. Never fabricate this value.

range.description: Export the active scene only or the whole project (default all)

reveal.description: Highlight the saved file in the system file manager when complete (default true)

name: poindeo_export_video
